Hi Claire, Ravi, and team —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood Inference. We often run short group demos for customers with similar inference needs (retail personalization and logistics routing), and thought it might be useful to show a combined 40-minute walkthrough + 20-minute breakout Q&A to cover both high-level architecture and quick integration questions.

Proposed structure (attached agenda):
- 0–5 min: intros & goals
- 5–25 min: demo of multi-tenant inference flows (latency/cost controls)
- 25–40 min: model routing + Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs (brief)
- 40–60 min: breakout rooms (retail / logistics) for product fit questions

Can you each indicate which of these 3 windows works best on your side (all times PT):
A) Tue Jul 20, 10:00–11:00 PT
B) Wed Jul 21, 15:00–16:00 PT
C) Thu Jul 22, 08:00–09:00 PT

If none work, tell us a 60-minute block and we’ll try to consolidate. Attaching a short agenda and a calendar .ics stub.

Mina
